scope.authorization_statement: Ledgerly is a fictional application shipped with BoundaryLens and started on this machine. The operator owns it and may test it.
scope.note: Authorized scan of a developer-owned target. Findings and evidence are sanitized: no passwords, session tokens or authorization headers are included.

checks_executed.title: Unauthenticated access to a protected resource

limitations: The scanner verifies the authorization rules declared in the manifest; it does not infer the application's complete business policy.
Confirmations are proven against seeded demo resources named in the manifest, not an exhaustive enumeration of every object.
Security-header and cookie items are hardening observations, interpreted for local HTTP development.
